svg.text: MoE decoder on mesh {'data': 2, 'expert': 2, 'fsdp': 2} of 8 simulated CPU devices, 8 experts, top-2, dispatch=exchange
compiled step: its program holds 24 all-to-all ops over mesh['data'=2,'expert'=2,'fsdp'=2,'tensor'=1,'sequence'=1,'stage'=1] {'expert'}
Arrows: routed slots a device sends to another in this step's forward, summed over the MoE layers (d, e, f = data, expert, fsdp coordinate).
Each training frame routes that step's own batch through the step's parameters; the last frame routes the generated text.
